tei:div.tei:p: "!# ye shes rab 'bar las/ bla ma longs sku'i sgrub pa 'chi med tshe sbyin bzhugs so:

ྈ drag po ye shes rab 'bar gyi dkyil 'khor du: bla ma longs sku'i sgrub pa'i thabs bstan pa: pad+ma thod phreng drag pos 'di skad smras: snying po'i nor bu rjes 'jug bu la sbyin: byang khog snying ltar gces spras dam du chongs: sa ma ya: bum pa'i snying po lnga tshan lnga dang bcas: snying po ril bu'i klong du bzhugs su gsol: tshe dar la sogs sgrub rten tshang bar bsags: ye shes rab 'bar drag po'i gzhung bsrangs nas: bskyed pa'i dpral ba bum pa'i 'khor lo na: pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru thabs shes sbyor ldan la: bla ma o rgyan longs sku tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: dar dang rin chen longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar gsal mtha' skor du: gsang ba snying po'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom: rtsa sngags bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi hūm̐:1$0000250 rtsa ba'i sngags phreng bla ma'i thugs kar 'phros: longs sku'i thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags kyis bskor/ sngags kyi phreng rgyun 'od zer lcags kyu ltar: 'jig rten khams kyi tshe bcud mnga' thang can: rgyal po rgyal phran mnga' thang bsod nams dang: snyan grags can gyi nus pa sngags phreng gi: rgyud nas drangs te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim: yul chen nyer bzhi gnas chen so gnyis dang: dur khrod brgyad sogs ming chen 'byung ba'i bcud: sa rdo ri brag chu shing 'byung ba'i bcud: rtsa ldum me tog bcud kyi dwangs ma rnams: 'od zer sna nas rigs bdag thugs kar thim: 1$0000300hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje'i zer: tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i pho nya ni: lā s+ye dkar mo grangs med kyis: phyag na tshe dar bum pa 'dzin: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang: 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs mar bcas: lā s+ye dkar mos tshe khug cig:

hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje'i zer: tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i pho nya ni: mā l+ye sngon mo grangs med kyis: phyag na tshe dar bum pa 'dzin: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang: 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs mar bcas: mā l+ye sngon mos tshe khug cig: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje'i zer: tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i pho nya ni: gīrti dmar mo grangs med kyis: phyag na tshe dar bum pa 'dzin: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang: 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs mar bcas: gīrti dmar mos tshe khug cig: hūm̐ hrī: tshe dpag med mgon thugs rje'i zer: tshe bcud 'gugs pa'i pho nya ni: nīrti ljang mo grangs med kyis: phyag na tshe dar bum pa 'dzin: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang: 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs mar bcas: nīrti ljang mos tshe khug cig: yang*/ hūm̐ hrī: longs sku tshe dpag med mgon gyi: pho nya mgyogs ma dkar mo'i rigs: thugs kyi sprul pa 'bum phrag gis: tshe bsod 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hrī: longs sku tshe dpag med mgon gyi: pho nya mgyogs ma ser mo'i rigs: yon tan sprul pa 'bum phrag gis: tshe bsod 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hrī: longs sku tshe dpag med mgon gyi: pho nya mgyogs ma dmar mo'i rigs: gsung gi sprul pa 'bum phrag gis: tshe bsod 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ hrī: longs sku tshe dpag med mgon gyi: pho nya mgyogs ma ljang mo'i rigs: phrin las sprul pa 'bum phrag gis: tshe bsod 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hrīḥlāṃ: tshe bdag sprul pa'i pho nya 'bum: sa yi lha mo sangs rgyas spyan: 'byung ba sa yi bcud sdus la: tshe ril rten la bcud sdus shig: hrīḥmāṃ: tshe bdag sprul pa'i pho nya 'bum: chu yi lha mo ma mā ki: 'byung ba chu yi bcud sdus la: tshe ril rten la bcud sdus shig: hrīḥpāṃ: tshe bdag sprul pa'i pho nya 'bum:

me yi lha mo gos dkar mos: 'byung ba me yi bcud sdus la: tshe ril rten la bcud sdus shig: hrīḥtāṃ: tshe bdag sprul pa'i pho nya 'bum: rlung gi lha mo dam tshig sgrol: 'byung ba rlung gi bcud sdus nas: tshe ril rten la bcud sdus shig: hrīḥ.ā: tshe bdag sprul pa'i pho nya 'bum: nam mkha'i lha mo dbyings phyug ma: 'byung ba nam mkha'i bcud sdus nas: tshe ril rten la bcud sdus shig: rnal 'byor sha yi tshe nyams na: sa yi bcud kyis stobs skyed cig: rnal 'byor khrag gi tshe nyams na: chu yi bcud kyis bkrag skyed cig: rnal 'byor drod kyi tshe nyams na: me yi bcud kyis mdangs skyed cig: rnal 'byor dbugs kyi tshe nyams na: rlung gi bcud kyis rtsal skyed cig: rnal 'byor sems kyi tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i khams kyi bcud sdus shig: tshe dang ye shes byin rlabs bcud: rnal 'byor rgyud la nus pa thob: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi ā yu ṣe hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥsarba sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ tshe bh+rūm̐: g.yu bh+rūm̐: g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: a yur+dzñā na g.yu tshe bh+rūm̐: rig pa ma yengs rtse gcig dmigs pa yi: gzhan gyi nus pa 'od zer sna la drangs: rten la bstim te nus pa bdag la thim: thun gyi 'jog tshe tshe dpag med la bstim: tshe dpag med mgon dbu ma'i lam la byon: he ru ka yi thugs kar zhugs par gyur: 'od zer 'phro 'dus bsre ba gong ltar te: dbyer med bde ba chen por 'dres par bsre: rdzogs rim stong gsal dbyer med tshe dpal la: skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i rang mdangs 'dra: skye 'gag gnas gsum bde klong 'khyil ba'i dus: skye 'chi gnyis med dgongs pa'i gzer theb pa: longs sku tshe dpag med kyi ngo bor 'grub: rang sems longs sku tshe dpag med mgon du: gnyis med bde klong 'khyil bar la bzla 'o: zab khyad mchog 'di pad+ma thod phreng gis: yang gro sprul bcas rjes 'jug btsas su gdams:
